question:
B. Is this measure already running in North Ostrobothnia wellbeing services county (or in the OYS university hospital area that treats its patients)?
A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure shorten the time from first symptom to treatment start for lung cancer patients, and by how many days?
Measure: EBUS as first test, with enough bronchoscopy capacity. Endobronchial ultrasound-guided needle biopsy as the first invasive test after CT for suspected stage I-IIIA disease, giving diagnosis and staging in one procedure, with enough EBUS lists (own or bought) to do it within a week.
effect_summary_en: In the Lung-BOOST randomised trial, the median time to treatment decision was 14 days with EBUS-TBNA first and 29 days with conventional work-up, so about 15 days shorter; the trial measured time to treatment decision, not time from first symptom to start of treatment.
supported_en: The Lancet Respiratory Medicine trial (2015) found a median time to treatment decision of 14 days with EBUS first versus 29 days with the usual work-up, about 15 days shorter.
not_supported_en: The trial did not measure time from first symptom to treatment start, and it was run in the UK, not Finland.
summary_en: B: We found no public sign that OYS or Pohde already uses EBUS as the first test with a one-week target. The OYS lung clinic page lists only imaging, lung function tests and lab tests, the OYS lung cancer pathway pages could not be opened (error 404), and a search for an OYS EBUS patient guide found none. A: A UK randomised trial (Lancet Respiratory Medicine, 2015) found a median time to treatment decision of 14 days with EBUS first versus 29 days with the usual work-up, which matches the 15 days we assume, but it measured time to treatment decision rather than time from first symptom to treatment start.
unanswered_en: We could not find OYS's own description of how suspected lung cancer is investigated or of its EBUS waiting times, because its pathway pages returned 404 errors and no OYS EBUS patient guide turned up.
